judged_text: Missing optional chaining crashes EventManager.create on empty/null destinationCalendar (packages/core/EventManager.ts:116-118) — `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` is accessed without `?.`, and this PR makes []/null a normal value for destinationCalendar, so a Meet-location booking/confirmation with an empty destination calendar throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined, causing a 500.

adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the diff introduces `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then immediately checks `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` without optional chaining. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null` or `[]` (both are now used in this PR, e.g. several builders set `: []`), `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and accessing `.integration` will throw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`, causing a 500 during `EventManager.create` for Meet-location events.
